Sample input 1: "1107"
column23:
1. 1. Open the Change Local Office picker dialog - a location-lookup API call fires (baseline check proving the network listener works)
  2. 2. assert postFired=true and locationCount > 0
  3. 3. Assert: Active checkbox is UNCHECKED (is not checked / data-state=unchecked) by default
  4. 4. Toggle Active to CHECKED - assert NO location-lookup API call fires (toggle is a client-side filter; server ignores activeOnly parameter)
  5. 5. assert checkbox is CHECKED
  6. 6. assert row list still renders rows
  7. 7. Search "1107" while Active is CHECKED - list narrows to matching offices (search and Active compose)
  8. 8. Clear search
  9. 9. toggle Active back to UNCHECKED - assert still NO location-lookup API call fires
  10. 10. assert checkbox is UNCHECKED
  11. 11. assert rows visible
  12. 12. Cancel
column26:
1. The picker dialog opens and a location-lookup API request fires.
2. The network request is confirmed fired and the picker displays a non-zero location count.
3. The Active checkbox is displayed unchecked by default.
4. The Active checkbox becomes checked and no additional location-lookup API request fires.
5. The Active checkbox is displayed checked.
6. The location row list continues to display rows.
7. The row list narrows to offices matching "1107" while the Active checkbox stays checked.
8. The search box clears and the full row list is restored.
9. The Active checkbox becomes unchecked and no additional location-lookup API request fires.
10. The Active checkbox is displayed unchecked.
11. The location row list is displayed with rows visible.
12. The picker closes and the original 1606 grid remains unaffected with no new location applied.
